overview.headline: Starting early lets compound interest grow savings for future education costs

keyPoints.point: Starting sooner with saving helps money grow faster through compound interest
keyPoints.quote: The sooner you start saving for post-secondary education, the faster your money can grow from compound interest.

keyPoints.point: Compound interest means earning interest on saved money and on prior interest earned
keyPoints.quote: Compound interest is when you earn interest on both the money you save and the interest you earn.

keyPoints.point: A principal of money can earn interest at a set rate with a compounding frequency once a year
keyPoints.quote: So let's say you invest $1,000 (your principal) and it earns 5 percent (interest rate) once a year (the compounding frequency).

keyPoints.point: Increasing compounding frequency or interest rate or adding to principal helps savings grow faster
keyPoints.quote: Increasing the compounding frequency or your interest rate or adding to your principal can help your savings grow even faster.

keyTerms.gloss: interest earned on money saved plus on interest already earned
keyTerms.quote: Compound interest: When you earn interest on both the money you save and the interest you earn.

keyTerms.gloss: percentage charged for borrowing or paid on deposited money
keyTerms.quote: Interest rate: A percentage of a sum borrowed that is charged by a lender or merchant for letting you use its money.

keyTerms.gloss: original principal amount that later earns interest
keyTerms.quote: So let's say you invest $1,000 (your principal) and it earns 5 percent (interest rate) once a year (the compounding frequency).

keyTerms.gloss: number of times per year that interest is compounded
keyTerms.quote: So let's say you invest $1,000 (your principal) and it earns 5 percent (interest rate) once a year (the compounding frequency).

keyTerms.gloss: something bought with money expected to earn a financial return
keyTerms.quote: Investment: Something you spend your money on that you expect will earn a financial return.

keyTerms.gloss: all forms of schooling pursued after high school
keyTerms.quote: Post-secondary education: Includes all forms of schooling after high school, not just college.
